title: DATESBETWEEN over a calendar from BLANK starts at the calendar's first date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "first", MINX ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, BLANK (), DATE ( 2008, 8, 5 ) ), 'Date'[Date] ), "last", MAXX ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, BLANK (), DATE ( 2008, 8, 5 ) ), 'Date'[Date] ), "days", COUNTROWS ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, BLANK (), DATE ( 2008, 8, 5 ) ) ) ), ALL ( 'Date' ) )

source.quote: With a calendar, it starts from the first value in the column tagged as Day.

derivation: The first date of Date is 2008-07-27: July 27 to August 5, 10 days.
